title: Send Outlook email with AI after a recipient check
h1: send an outlook email with the details checked
description: Let a bot prepare and send an Outlook email with a subject, body and optional files. Review recipients and attachments using Metal's sending controls.
answer: **get the final dispatch note to the customer without another round of copying.** give the bot an outlook recipient, subject and text, plus files and any cc or bcc. it prepares a preview and sends after you allow it by default. you can also set a daily amount. this action sends immediately rather than saving a draft.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: the right message to the right address.
what:
**turn the agreed words and final file into a ready-to-send email.** the bot needs a recipient, subject and body. it can attach one file or several; each needs content, a valid name and a file type.

a different from address needs send-as or send-on-behalf permission. typing an address grants nothing. use plain text unless formatting matters; the body and chosen format must match.
uses: email an agreed delivery note to the warehouse address you name
send a workshop access letter with its final pdf
send a short internal notice to a fixed list
write a new supplier request as a new email, rather than pretending it belongs to an old thread

routine.message:
every thursday at 10:10, read final dispatch notes added this week to my local dispatch folder. use the customer contact address in each note. skip any note without a final mark or a complete address. show each recipient, subject, full body and attachment name here.

wait for my approval before sending through outlook. save a sent-items copy and report the result. never replace recipients or use unfinished files. if a send result is unclear, ask me before trying again.
routine.needs: outlook with read and write; access to the dispatch folder; sending set to ask every time
routine.output:
dispatch email for review
- customer: rachel at rivermint ceramics
- to: address from the final dispatch note
- subject: dispatch note for the kiln shelves
- attachment: final-dispatch-note.pdf
show the full address and body before allowing this send.

steps: connect the outlook mailbox and give the dispatch bot read and write.
set **Sending on your behalf** to **Ask every time**.
give the recipient address and final file. ask to see every recipient, the body and attachment name.
open the sent-items copy after the first send, then schedule the folder review.
watch: careful with **Full access**: a bot there with no sending rule can send up to 25 a day without asking. give it **Ask every time**.
**use the full recipient address.** a name alone leaves room for a wrong match. a different from mailbox also needs permission.
**an attachment can fail the send.** empty files, missing names or missing file types need fixing first.

faq.q: can it send the same email to more than one person?
faq.a: **yes, including cc and bcc.** primary recipients can use comma-separated addresses. cc and bcc have separate lists. inspect all three before allowing the send.

faq.q: can it send from our shared mailbox?
faq.a: **only with the right mailbox permission.** the action accepts a from address. the connected account still needs send-as or send-on-behalf access.

steps: connect outlook and set sending to ask every time
ask for a short test email addressed to yourself
read the full preview and allow that send

mistakes.fix: ask for each filename and make sure it matches the final copy.

mistakes.mistake: retrying when the send result is unclear
mistakes.fix: look in sent items and ask before sending again.

tip.text: look in sent items before retrying. the customer may already have the first email.
